posts.trend: IBM India leases 2.83 lakh sq ft of office space in Bengaluru for ₹343 crore over 10 years
posts.context: Corporate physical presence is tracked like primary school attendance.
posts.angle: The modern tech park is an adult daycare where presence is verified by turnstiles.
slides: Your manager needs you in the office for your personal growth.

Log in at 9:00 AM.
Swipe at turnstile.
Thoda alignment call in the cafeteria.
Headphones on till 6:00 PM.

By 2 PM you have spoken to two people.
Both said, 'Ek second screen share karta hoon.'
posts.caption: Every team has one person who keeps their bag on the desk to mark attendance.
posts.rank_verdict: The final line merely extends the middle slide's routine rather than landing on a distinct punchline.
